svg.title: Inverting Spectral Coordinates in the P3 Basis
svg.desc: Left: the connected part of the cone a>0, 0<b≤3a; right: its image α>0, β≥α/3. The green sectors a/3≤b≤3a and α/3≤β≤3α correspond to both the Laplacian and Greenian satisfying graph sign conditions. The orange sector b<a/3 maps to β>3α, where the Greenian violates these signs. The example (4,1) maps to (1/4,1) and gives Gr13=1/24>0.

cc:Work.dc:description: Left: the connected part of the cone a>0, 0<b≤3a; right: its image α>0, β≥α/3. The green sectors a/3≤b≤3a and α/3≤β≤3α correspond to both the Laplacian and Greenian satisfying graph sign conditions. The orange sector b<a/3 maps to β>3α, where the Greenian violates these signs. The example (4,1) maps to (1/4,1) and gives Gr13=1/24>0.
